title: Decide whether starter components change colour with the Mac appearance
goal: The Library's starter Button, Badge and friends are painted in the variants mock's light colours and keep them when the Mac switches to dark mode, the way a picture you drew keeps its colours. The mock also has dark-mode colours for the same controls. Ask the user which they want before building anything.
notes: From the-starter-button-comes-as-primary-secondary-or acceptance 4 ("in light and dark"). Today StarterStyle colours are document colours (ColorStyle has one hex), so a document reads the same whatever the appearance; the panel and canvas chrome follow the appearance. Mock dark tokens: docs/design/mocks/shared/components/tokens.css lines ~156-192 (--accent #7f9bff, --accent-ink #0b0d14, --ink #e7e9ee, --dim #b0b6c2).
acceptance: A decision card asks the user whether starter components keep their colours or follow the Mac's appearance, with a brief
If they choose to follow it, the starter styles carry a dark value and a dropped Button matches the mock's dark cells in dark mode
